description: This file contains unit tests for the OrderFrequencyValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for OrderFrequency objects.

classes.name: OrderFrequencyValidatorTest
classes.description: A test class for validating the behavior of OrderFrequencyValidator in different scenarios.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfOrderFrequencyIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the OrderFrequency object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the concept within OrderFrequency is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheConceptIsNotOfClassFrequency
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the concept's class is not of type frequency.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptIsUsedByAnotherFrequency
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the concept is already associated with another order frequency.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAValidNewOrderFrequency
methods.description: Confirms that validation passes for a properly constructed new OrderFrequency.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAValidExistingOrderFrequency
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes for an existing OrderFrequency retrieved from context.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeInvokedWhenAnOrderFrequencyIsSaved
methods.description: Tests that saving an invalid OrderFrequency triggers an APIException with the correct message.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when string fields are within acceptable length bounds.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when string fields exceed maximum allowed length.
